mapper.select: WITH ranked_dispatch AS ( SELECT a.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY a.person_key ORDER BY a.assignment_date DESC, a.reg_dtm DESC, a.assignment_key DESC ) AS dispatch_rank FROM hrm_assignment a WHERE a.del_yn = 'N' AND a.assignment_type_code = '105-030' AND a.grade_code = '102-060' AND a.dispatch_country_code IS NOT NULL AND a.assignment_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND (a.assignment_end_date IS NULL OR a.assignment_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) ) SELECT p.employee_no, p.person_key, p.name_ko AS name, c.country_name_ko AS country, a.dispatch_country_code AS country_code, NULL::TEXT AS city, NULL::TEXT AS region, c.map_latitude AS latitude, c.map_longitude AS longitude, a.assignment_date AS dispatched_date, a.assignment_date AS dispatch_date, a.assignment_content, a.dispatch_country_code AS group_key FROM ranked_dispatch a JOIN hrm_person p ON p.person_key = a.person_key JOIN sys_country_code c ON c.country_code = a.dispatch_country_code WHERE a.dispatch_rank = 1 AND p.service_status_code = '101-010' AND (p.retire_date IS NULL OR p.retire_date > CURRENT_DATE) AND c.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY a.assignment_date ASC, p.employee_no ASC
